capabilities.name: Read a GitHub repository
capabilities.description: Clone and read the GitHub repositories its grant names. For each run its machine is lent a token that works only for those repositories, read only, for at most an hour, and is withdrawn when the run ends or its grant no longer covers it.

repository_id.description: GitHub's number for the repository, which one deleted and made again under the same name does not keep

capabilities.name: Write to a GitHub repository
capabilities.description: Clone, commit, push and open pull requests in the GitHub repositories its grant names. For each run its machine is lent a token that works only for those repositories, for at most an hour, and is withdrawn when the run ends or its grant no longer covers it.

repository_id.description: GitHub's number for the repository, which one deleted and made again under the same name does not keep
